name: automode
what: Stream / dev / idle mode every 20 s: pauses OpenClaw and heavy jobs while you stream or work with Claude.

name: reel
what: Fetch an Instagram reel's video and caption without logging in.

name: reel-library
what: Download, transcribe (FreeLLMAPI Whisper), group and NSFW-flag a list of reels; writes ~/reels-library/index.md.

name: clip
what: Stream clips: GPU transcription on Kaggle, captions, punch zooms, to the Clip studio.

name: kaggle-run
what: Run a Kaggle GPU job (textures, scenes, room images, transcribe) and fetch the results.

name: yt-history-sync
what: Your YouTube watch history → Soma → Media → Watched, every 6 h.

name: freellm
what: Ask the homelab's FreeLLMAPI (free models, smart routing).

name: openclaw-watchdog
what: Restarts OpenClaw when a linked chat channel goes unhealthy.

name: ps5-play
what: Before Remote Play: is the controller, PS5 and network ready? While playing: alerts if the TV turns itself on.

name: deals-fetch
what: Deal Check's OLX search for your wishlist, every 3 h.

name: new-tool
what: Start a new tool from the template (forge README, step 1).

name: desk-display
what: ESP32 + OLED on the desk: homelab state, approve button (plan).

name: album-scan
what: Digitise the photo albums into Immich (plan).

name: sell-it
what: Priced OLX listings for things you sell (plan + prices).

name: tv-tidy
what: Debloat the LG OLED (settings, AdGuard rules) (plan).

name: teams-transcribe
what: Teams recording → transcript + summary, decisions, action items, from its videomanifest URL (or an mp4).

name: wardrobe
what: Everything in your wardrobe with photos, outfits, and ask it what to wear (plan).
